correctness.rationale: Every 4-set of F2^d rows is an affine plane (P=N(N-1)(N-2)/24) or independent tetrahedron (T=N(N-1)(N-2)(N-4)/24). The respective character projections onto 4 or 8 types have fiber sizes u=N/4,v=N/8. Plane-row rank equals number of distinct projected types. Independent-row distinct four-projection local classification of C(8,4)=70 cube sets yields 56 full-rank |det|8, two even-parity affine planes full-rank |det|16, remaining twelve affine planes rank3; repeated types give ranks 1,2,3 by occupancy. Counting type multiplicities gives the claimed all-dimensional A1..A4 formulas and determinant counts. Independent direct C++ enumerator of original 4x4 ±1 Walsh minors with exact integer elimination—not the submitted dephased determinant code—checked all 4900 submatrix pairs at N=8 and all 3,312,400 at N=16, obtaining ranks (0,84,1344,3472) and (560,104160,1612800,1594880), and |det|8,16 counts (3136,336) and (1505280,89600). The all-d proof relies on fixed local cube classification, not finite extrapolation.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks alone are not an all-size theorem; the unrestricted proof and normalization were read in RESULT.md.
